title: SEC Crypto Task Force Announces New Key Crypto Roundtable
summary: SEC Crypto Task Force has scheduled a public hearing on financial privacy and surveillance for Oct. 17, 1–4 p.m. at SEC headquarters; speakers will be named later. Commissioner Hester M. Peirce has said privacy tools can inform policy. The SEC has also launched a Cross-Border Task Force. title: DOJ Targets $5M Stolen Bitcoin in SIM Swap Crackdown Across U.S
summary: The DOJ has sought forfeiture of over $5M in Bitcoin connected to alleged Sim Swap thefts and has said investigators have traced transactions through several wallets to a Stake.com-linked account, as the FBI has reported a 66% rise in crypto fraud losses year over year.
